versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

Initial release of the Junk Drawer 5-Minute Reset skill.

- Provides a printable, step-by-step card for a five-minute junk drawer reset.
- Uses simple "keep, move, trash, caution" micro-zones to sort items quickly.
- Includes safety tips and clear boundaries for what tasks not to attempt.
- Offers a customizable drawer map and reset label for easy organization.
- Focuses on fast wins—no full decluttering, donation, or deep sorting.
